articles.title: Don Cooper, pitching coach for White Sox’s 2005 World Series championship team, dies at 70
articles.description: Don Cooper, a longtime Chicago White Sox pitching coach who helped the franchise win the 2005 World Series, died at 70, the team announced Wednesday afternoon. The cause has not been revealed.
